name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: Cybersecurity risk management framework mappings for WinSec Analyzer.

functions.name: GOVERN
functions.description: Establish and monitor cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations and policy.

functions.name: IDENTIFY
functions.description: Understand cybersecurity risks to systems, assets and operations.

functions.name: PROTECT
functions.description: Implement safeguards to manage cybersecurity risks.

functions.name: DETECT
functions.description: Identify and analyze possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises.

functions.name: RESPOND
functions.description: Take action regarding detected cybersecurity incidents.

functions.description: Restore assets and operations affected by cybersecurity incidents.

subcategories.name: Protect networks and environments from unauthorized logical access and usage
Maintain, replace and remove software according to risk

references.title: Protect data at rest
references.description: NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS-01 concerns confidentiality, integrity and availability of data at rest. BitLocker contributes confidentiality; these two local checks do not demonstrate the complete outcome. CSF specifies outcomes rather than a mandatory BitLocker algorithm or key length.
references.recommendation: Review the organization's data-at-rest risk and protection policy, recovery arrangements and complementary integrity and availability safeguards. Have an authorized administrator address confirmed encryption or protection deviations. Assess algorithm and key length against applicable cryptographic requirements, then repeat the read-only scan.

references.title: Prevent unauthorized software
references.description: The outcome concerns prevention of unauthorized software. Defender protection is one contributing safeguard, not complete evidence of this CSF outcome.
references.recommendation: Document the approved protection baseline and exceptions, review the disabled protection against that baseline, and have the authorized administrator restore the approved configuration. Confirm it with another read-only assessment.

references.title: Monitor computing environments and data
references.description: The outcome concerns monitoring computing environments for adverse events. Behavior monitoring contributes context; this check does not assess the complete monitoring program.
references.recommendation: Review whether disabling behavior monitoring was authorized, document the monitoring gap, and restore the approved protection through authorized administration. Retain and review relevant monitoring records separately.

references.title: Maintain, replace and remove software according to risk
references.description: PR.PS-02 concerns risk-informed software maintenance. Automatic OS update configuration contributes to maintenance; it does not demonstrate the entire CSF outcome.
references.recommendation: Review the confirmed automation deviation with the administrator and risk owner. Resolve conflicting policies, document approved maintenance responsibilities and verify deployment through supported administration. Reassess without changing the recorded result.

references.title: Maintain, replace and remove software according to risk
references.description: The missing reviewed cumulative Windows baseline provides partial maintenance context. CSF 2.0 does not prescribe WinSec weights or a universal seven-day patch deadline.
references.recommendation: Prioritize the confirmed baseline gap using business impact, exposure and vulnerability risk. Have the administrator validate compatibility and complete approved deployment and restart arrangements; verify other products separately.

references.title: Maintain, replace and remove software according to risk
references.description: Software replacement when vendor maintenance ends contributes to PR.PS-02. This observed Windows lifecycle result does not assess organizational risk acceptance or certify the outcome.
references.recommendation: Have the risk owner and administrator plan migration to a supported Windows release, with compatibility, recovery and continuity arrangements. Document any temporary exception and residual risk separately; do not relabel the historical result.

references.title: Protect networks and environments from unauthorized logical access and usage
references.description: Host Firewall configuration contributes context to network filtering. Disabled profiles, permissive defaults and broad exceptions require review. Logging is complementary monitoring context. These observations do not prove compliance, reachability, exploitation or complete mitigation.
references.recommendation: Review the effective policy for Domain, Private and Public profiles, approved application and service exceptions, block precedence, and monitoring requirements. Have an authorized administrator apply the approved filtering policy; reassess through a confirmed read-only scan.
